content.title: The U.S. Just Took Japan's K-pop Crown — And the $120M Quarter Is the Warning Shot
content.excerpt: K-pop album exports hit $120M in Q1 2026, and the U.S. passed Japan. The shift could change how agencies plan the next export push.

factCheck.claim: Q1 2026 K-pop album exports reached US$120 million.
The Q1 total rose 159 percent year over year and marked the first quarter above US$100 million.
The United States became the largest export market, overtaking Japan.
Q1 exports reached 131 countries and 94 of them posted record first-quarter imports.
2025 full-year K-pop album exports reached US$301.7 million.
Overall 2025 album sales fell for a second consecutive year to roughly 93.5 million units.
